personas.name: neglect-standard-with-consent
personas.description: Teacher-referred neglect concern with parental consent given and no immediate danger — expect standard urgency with the mandatory rules satisfied.

family.carers: Mother and stepfather at home address

concern.concernDescription: Persistent hunger, unwashed clothing, and repeated lateness over the last half-term; child says there is often no food at home in the mornings.

flaggedIssues.description: The child has made a disclosure of abuse — the account must be preserved and prioritised.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Record the child’s own words, avoid leading questions, do not investigate, and pass the account to children’s social care and, where relevant, the police.

flaggedIssues.description: Sexual abuse is recorded as a category — this needs a specialist and possibly a police / medical response.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Do not examine or question the child. Contact children’s social care and the police so a joint specialist assessment can be arranged; preserve any evidence.

flaggedIssues.description: The child / family are not aware of the referral because informing them would increase risk — contact must be handled carefully.
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Note the reason informing would increase risk and agree with children’s social care how and when the family will be told.

flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Record the lawful basis for sharing (risk of serious harm, or that seeking consent would increase risk), or seek consent, per Working Together 2023 and the Information Sharing guidance.
